rel_notes.n:
* PXT-1715/1726: Close query resources when a query stops; fix export_lancedb() with lancedb 0.41 by @mkornacker in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1868
* Start the local database on first use, not in Env.get() by @mkornacker in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1909

* Cap standard+ at -n 8 to stay within the test Postgres server's connections by @aaron-siegel in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1870
* [PXT-1579] Trace hosted services and databases by @christopherpestano in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1749
* Expect EXIT_REFUSED when pxt db update refuses a capacity cut by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1862

## What's Changed
* ci: run pytest-xdist with -n logical (one worker per vCPU); skip uv cache clean on Windows by @agarg21 in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1807
* pin miniforge to last working version to 26.7.2-1 by @sergey-mkhitaryan in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1812
* Fix the 2026-10-23 nightly failures by @aaron-siegel in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1810
* Bind Claude reviews to fixed source and verified findings by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.c

* Add pxt feedback, which shows a report for the Pixeltable team and sends it only with --send by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1782
* PXT-1564: pxt db diff/update --add-config-entry by @mkornacker in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1784
* Keep error codes in failed requests; pxt db usage exits 1; next lines after hosted waits and secret changes by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1780

* PXT-1569: remove Env.is_using_cockroachdb() by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1771
* Open the database tunnel through HTTPS_PROXY, and report an intercepted handshake by @aaron-siegel in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1748

## What's Changed
* PXT-1554: service sizing via the config by @mkornacker in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1741
* Add an always-on Claude erosion check to the PR reviewer by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1770
* [PXT-1495] Database and service orchestration (Client-side change) by @sergey-mkhitaryan in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1701


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/compare/v0.7.17...v0.7.18

* Fail fast with a clear error when the database tunnel's TCP connect times out by @aaron-siegel in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1733
* Default the database tunnel to port 443 by @aaron-siegel in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1746

* Sign hosted media reads instead of holding bucket credentials (PXT-1520), and read pxt://{org}:{db}/buckets/home/... as pxtfs:// by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1718
* Write pxt://{org}:{db}/buckets/home/... for home-bucket media (re-land #1722 onto main) by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1734
* pxt db update: print the pending plan once on non-tty refusal by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1707

v2.0.9 (2026-10-29)
Table of Contents Grouping — Groups from primary sources stay together ahead of other sources, and groups are sorted by their display name so related groups groups sit side by side.
Feature Layer Labels — Feature layers can display labels from a configured label field.
Feature Layer Identify — Improved query handling and response normalization for feature layers in Identify.
Bag Tag Locations — Added a URL parameter to open bag tag purchase locations directly.

MyMaps Reordering — Drag and drop MyMaps items to change their order.
Follow Location — Follow your location on the map, with a point marker and a track line.
Favourites and Recent Layers — Mark layers as favourites in the Table of Contents, and reopen recently used layers from a dropdown in the TOC header.
Feature Search — Search returns features from WFS and ArcGIS layers, not only places.

MyMaps Rotate — Rotate MyMaps features, with undo support for geometry changes.
Related Records — Results, Identify, and the Attribute Table show related ArcGIS records, with report details loaded on demand.
Basemap Imagery — Removed the 2026 imagery service and restored the 2025 imagery service in the Basemap Switcher due to quality issues.

v2.0.6 (2026-10-15)
Timed Layer Refresh — Layers with a refresh interval or time dimension get play/pause controls, and Folder headers and List group selectors control every refreshable layer in that group.
WMS Time Slider — WMS layers with a time dimension show a slider that steps through available times, and dragging the slider pauses playback.
Layer Setup Keywords — Added REFRESH_INTERVAL and CATEGORY keyword support for publishers, documented in Layer Setup

Sidebar Navigation & Deep Linking — Added sidebar shortcut URL parameters to navigate directly into specific tools and themes.
Waze Event Information — Expanded Waze traffic feed popup content with richer event details and formatted descriptions.
ArcGIS Token Print Support — Enhanced Print Tool request handling with ArcGIS token management to support printing secured map and basemap services.
Search Usability Improvements — Added automatic whitespace trimming to search inputs
